disclaimer.title: Life Matters — Historical Scenario Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: The historical scenarios and character simulations in this tool are based on public academic literature and historical records, intended solely for health decision-making education.
disclaimer.points: Simulations do not represent moral judgments of historical figures.
Historical data is simplified and does not constitute medical advice.
Scenarios involving real persons are for educational purposes, adhering to Fair Use principles.
Simulation results are model projections, not factual historical reconstructions.
disclaimer.academic: Life Matters is an academic simulation tool for educational purposes only. Historical scenarios are based on publicly available literature and do not represent moral judgments of historical figures.
